submission.natural_language_explanation: L11/N2978+ is a physical-description detector: it fires on the words that locate or portray a concrete thing in space - locative/postural predicates ('sits', 'stands', 'lies', 'located', 'situated', 'central'), the prepositions and determiners that introduce them ('in', 'on', 'at', 'under', 'along', 'a', 'the'), attributive physical modifiers of a concrete noun ('plump', 'glossy', 'narrow', 'sleek', 'thin and transparent', 'encased') and measure words ('inch', 'half', 'yard'). It is near-silent (max ~0) on legal, procedural, code and abstract/technical prose, which contains the same prepositions and determiners but no concrete object being described, placed or measured.
